newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star Technology says names Best coo.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star Technology says names Best coo.

text.p: Lone Star Technologies Inc said Tuesday that it named Rhys Best as its president and chief operating officer. Best steps into these newly created positions after serving as the and chief executive officer of Lone Star Steel Co since 1989. He also held the title of president at Lone Star Steel, the principal operating company of Lone Star Technologies, the company said in a statement.
The company added that Byron Dunn has been promoted to the take Best's place as president and chief executive officer of Lone Start Steel. Lone Star said Dunn has been with the company for 22 years.
